historical_commentary.text: This note documents a 4D plug-in that statically bundled ImageMagick 6.2.7 to give 4D 2004 built-in image manipulation (resize, crop, rotate, format conversion) without requiring a separate ImageMagick install on client machines. The plug-in mechanism itself, and standalone binary plug-ins built against a specific old ImageMagick release, are long superseded by modern 4D's built-in picture-handling commands and newer image libraries; the underlying idea of embedding an image-processing library as a deployable component remains conceptually sound. Cross-platform picture handling in 4D has since matured considerably beyond what a 2006-era Mac/Windows plug-in could offer.
related_updates: 4D has since expanded its native picture/image-handling commands, reducing reliance on third-party plug-ins like this one
The specific plug-in binary and bundled ImageMagick 6.2.7 version described here are no longer maintained or distributed
